identity.instrumentFamily: Burnout Assessment Tool WORK, zh-Hans; independently versioned source candidate

construct.constructDefinition: BAT23 工作版简体中文；独立的23项原版候选。工作版、一般版和次级症状不混用，题号身份不推出计分/常模。

population.populationNotes: BAT WORK 候选，原始研究人群并非中国K12教师；18+仅为项目目录范围。英文/中文不同版本不可互换。

administration.timeFrame: 必须以该语言与工作/一般原版指导语为准；当前只建立目录，不是可施测指导语
layoutConstraints: 仅登记BAT23 工作版简体中文、23项和精确原选题线索：1–23，不包含公开题文/锚点/可执行计分。
工作版与一般版语境不同，中文简体与英文版题意或选题存在差异，不可自动对应或替换。
作者网站提示免费使用、原工具不得改题并须引用；不自动推导当前提取包的公开再分发或中文改写权。
没有中国K12教师正式常模、阈值和经验证个人报告。

intendedUses.notes: 仅目录来源索引。授权与版本差异核清前不提供工作/一般版可执行题本。

localization.translationSource: Official author-hosted BAT23 工作版简体中文 source identified at burnoutassessmenttool.be; not copied into this catalog. Version-specific Chinese/English item mismatches remain pending.
localization.notes: Original selection 1–23; gaps OFFICIAL_ITEM9_SEMANTIC_MISMATCH,PUBLIC_REDISTRIBUTION_SCOPE_NOT_ESTABLISHED. Do not overwrite BAT23 work English, BAT12 work English, or BAT-S10 English candidates.

source.title: Burnout Assessment Tool — BAT23 工作版简体中文
source.citation: Schaufeli, Desart & De Witte (2020), Burnout Assessment Tool (BAT): Development, Validity, and Reliability, IJERPH 17(24), 9495; author-hosted current work/general and Chinese language forms (precise version status must be checked).

limitations: Only source metadata, 23 items; no executable C, scoring S, parameter P or personal report R.
Original work vs general and English vs Simplified Chinese variants are distinct. Unresolved item9 and general short-form crosswalk issues cannot be repaired speculatively.
The BAT author site permits free use without altering the instrument, but no new adapted editable version or third-party PDF is redistributed here. No verified China K12 norms or thresholds.
reportPlan.disclaimer: 目录候选；不诊断、不计分、不公开施测。
